about.title: About Tanzania Global
about.story: Tanzania Global exists because a student in Tanzania should not have to guess their way to a university. Study abroad is a chain: the right country, a college or university the family can afford, exams on time, a statement that sounds like the student, and a visa that matches the offer. From Dar es Salaam, Arusha, Mwanza, Zanzibar, and towns across the country, that chain is easy to start from a brochure and hard to finish alone. We sit with families — in Swahili when it helps — and run it in order, so the applications we open can actually finish.
about.mission: An offer letter is not the finish. For a family in Tanzania, success is a college or university they can afford, a visa filed correctly, and a student who arrives ready — with someone still answering after they land. We do not treat a brochure country as a win. We treat a finished file as a win: the right place, the money lined up, and the first week at college or university already planned.
